# origincloud_compute_volume_attachments (Data Source)

Lists an instance's volume attachments, the boot volume's first, then by device name. With `-` for the instance, lists every instance's in the zone, which with `volume` finds the instance holding a volume. Detached attachments aren't listed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance` (String) The instance whose volume attachments to list.
- `project` (String) The project whose volume attachments to list.
- `zone` (String) The zone whose volume attachments to list.

### Read-Only

- `volume_attachments` (Attributes List) The volume attachments listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volume_attachments))

<a id="nestedatt--volume_attachments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volume_attachments`

Read-Only:

- `boot` (Boolean) Whether this is the instance's boot volume, which was attached at launch and can't be detached.
- `device` (String) The device name the guest sees the volume under, `vda` to `vdz`. The first free one when left empty.
- `name` (String) The attachment's resource name.
- `state` (String) Where the attachment is. One of `CREATING`, `ATTACHING`, `ATTACHED`, `DETACHING`, `RELEASING`, `RELEASE_ABANDONED`, `FAILED`.
- `urn` (String) The attachment's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.
- `volume` (String) The volume, in the instance's project and zone.
